title: Tom Bradley International Terminal, LAX — wider view (AI preview)
credit: Private test footage at Tom Bradley International Terminal, LAX. An 8-second preview with edges extended with AI so you can look a little farther. The clip loops. Audio is off.
pathNote: No route map for this short preview: the mini-map is hidden.
creditDetails: Flat video, not 360. This is an 8-second segment of the Tom Bradley walk (about 1:52–2:00 of the full clip) whose edges were extended with AI so drag-to-look can move farther before hitting the edge of the footage. The real camera frame sits in the centre, about two-thirds of the picture; the border around it was generated. Model: FLUX.1 Fill [dev], run on the free Hugging Face Space multimodalart/flux-fill-outpaint. It is a test preview, not a finished production treatment, and not a 360 capture. The clip loops. Clip audio was omitted because travelers and staff can be heard. The full 2:34 walk is a separate entry and was not altered. Place: same as that walk, about 33.9439 N, 118.4081 W. Travelers and staff appear in the frame and have not been asked about public display; check consent before any public launch.
